text: Measurement-device-independent QKD (MDI-QKD) removes all detector side-channel attacks such as detector blinding. How is its architecture arranged?
choices: Alice keeps all detectors in a shielded vault that Eve cannot physically access
Detectors are replaced entirely by homodyne receivers that are immune to blinding
Alice and Bob are both transmitters, sending weak decoy-state pulses to an untrusted relay that performs a Bell-state measurement and publicly announces the outcome
Each photon is measured twice and the two results are compared to detect tampering
explanation: MDI-QKD makes both parties transmitters and hands all detection to an untrusted middle relay performing a Bell-state measurement; the relay learns nothing about the key even if Eve owns it, removing every detector side channel (it reached 404 km in fiber). Choice 0 (shielding) does not address the protocol; choice 1 describes CV-QKD; choice 3 would require copying a photon, which no-cloning forbids.
